role: Post-result source and event-concentration review of the already chosen COIN contributor; not original preregistration, new signal, event-alpha strategy or OOS evidence.
selection: Every fixed-window issuer filing whose exact Item list contains 2.02; retain preliminary guidance/restructuring and corrections separately from actual quarterly earnings. No filtering by realized return or timestamp availability.
original_documents: Complete SEC SGML submissions, exact raw acceptance UTC versus existing API, primary8K and every HTML earnings exhibit with original offsets and SHA. Issuer IR releases and advance earnings-date announcements separately captured.

clock_policy.first_public_at: Unknown unless established by original evidence; a source publication clock cannot prove no earlier channel.
clock_policy.date_only: Date-only or timezone-ambiguous metadata is an interval/unknown, never midnight actual publication.
clock_policy.webcast_start: Do not use Q&A start as earnings publication.
clock_policy.planned_after_close: A planned release slot is not evidence of actual first-release time.
clock_policy.historical_site_metadata: Captured in 2026; source-reported historical dates are not independently timestamped historical delivery observations.

fixed_account_diagnostic.anchor: First regular stock session whose close follows the exact SEC acceptance clock. Label explicitly as filing-anchored, not first-news-anchored.
fixed_account_diagnostic.window: One mechanically determined session per filing, no +/-day search. Preopen and afterclose map by actual frozen calendar; intraday clocks flagged because daily PnL cannot isolate their reaction.
metrics: COIN overnight/intraday/net marked PnL and costs
remaining sessions and total contribution reconciliation
fixed_account_diagnostic.interpretation: Descriptive dollar accounting only. Removing event-day sums is not an executable strategy, and publication proximity does not prove causality. No economic return rerun.
